page.notes: Right margin is empty; no marginal notes. Arabic passages are transcribed as best read from the scan; the exact letters of the Arabic lines (notably "الغر قة", "الـمجبرة", "ينسبون", "والايجاد", and the final words of the last line) are uncertain and marked [?]. Possible printing variants "afferunt" / "asserunt" and "tranferretur" are left as printed. The first word "tes" is a fragment and kept as such.
